DeleteNodesClusterScalingV2.deleteOption: Delete option. If empty, uses the node's own DeleteOption configuration
DeleteNodesClusterScalingV2.deleteOption.moveOut: Move the node out of the cluster without deleting it
DeleteNodesClusterScalingV2.deleteOption.deleteResource: Delete the node and its associated resources
DeleteNodesClusterScalingV2.deleteOption.deleteCDSSnapshot: Delete the CDS snapshots associated with the node
DeleteNodesClusterScalingV2.instanceIDs: List of node IDs to delete
DeleteNodesClusterScalingV2.scaleDown: Whether to simultaneously decrease the desired node count of the node group where the deleted nodes reside
